SELECT pa.application_id AS applicationId, pa.project_id AS projectId, pa.freelancer_id AS freelancerId, pa.application_status AS applicationStatus, pa.applied_at AS appliedAt, u.name AS freelancerName, u.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl,
-- 평점 계산 IFNULL((SELECT ROUND(AVG(c.client_rating), 1) FROM contracts c JOIN project_applications pa2 ON c.contract_id = pa2.application_id WHERE pa2.freelancer_id = pa.freelancer_id AND c.client_rating IS NOT NULL), 0.0) AS rating,
-- 대표 기술 스택 1개 IFNULL((SELECT s.stack_name FROM freelancer_skills fs JOIN stacks s ON fs.stack_id = s.stack_id WHERE fs.freelancer_id = pa.freelancer_id ORDER BY fs.stack_level DESC, fs.stack_year DESC LIMIT 1), '미등록') AS mainSkill,
-- 경력 연차 IFNULL((SELECT MAX(stack_year) FROM freelancer_skills WHERE freelancer_id = pa.freelancer_id), 0) AS careerYear
FROM project_applications pa JOIN users u ON pa.freelancer_id = u.user_id WHERE pa.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY pa.applied_at DESC

SELECT pa.application_id AS applicationId, pa.freelancer_id AS freelancerId, pa.application_status AS applicationStatus, u.name AS freelancerName, u.email AS email, u.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl,
fp.introduction AS introduction, fp.github_url AS githubUrl, fp.website_url AS websiteUrl, fp.school_name AS schoolName, fp.major AS major, fp.grad_status AS graduationStatus,
-- 평점 계산 IFNULL((SELECT ROUND(AVG(c.client_rating), 1) FROM contracts c JOIN project_applications pa2 ON c.contract_id = pa2.application_id WHERE pa2.freelancer_id = pa.freelancer_id AND c.client_rating IS NOT NULL), 0.0) AS rating,
(SELECT portfolio_url FROM freelancer_portfolios WHERE freelancer_id = pa.freelancer_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS portfolioUrl
FROM project_applications pa JOIN users u ON pa.freelancer_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN freelancer_profiles fp ON pa.freelancer_id = fp.freelancer_id
WHERE pa.application_id = #{applicationId}
SELECT s.stack_name FROM freelancer_skills fs JOIN stacks s ON fs.stack_id = s.stack_id WHERE fs.freelancer_id = #{freelancerId} ORDER BY fs.stack_level DESC

SELECT company_name AS companyName, role AS role, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, description AS description FROM freelancer_careers WHERE freelancer_id = #{freelancerId} ORDER BY start_date DESC

SELECT title AS title, client_name AS clientName, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, description AS description FROM freelancer_project_experiences WHERE freelancer_id = #{freelancerId} ORDER BY start_date DESC
